Mit unserem Setup gemessen (3 von 3 Seeds, Zielwert 0.372 +/- 0.01, tab:FITSett, arXiv v3 (latex)): Mittel 0.3720. Code-Kandidaten: 3, gewaehlt Kandidat 0 (Code de18d490e610) nach Validierungs-Metrik (0: mse 0.4697, 1: mse 0.4697, 2: mse 0.4703); Repo comparison incomplete: files were truncated or findings could not be verified. Method fidelity remains unchecked.; Independent selection used the final 20% of validation observations, withheld from fitting; checkpoint selection used the remaining visible validation data. Original train/test splits unchanged.; Forecast histories were streamed chronologically to an unprivileged predictor after fitting; each forecast was recorded before the next history was exposed.

objection_checks.rule: protocol_change (drop_last): no new run and no new code. Our harness recomputes the claim metric from the same agent predictions on the test windows a loader with drop_last=True keeps (batch sizes 32, 64, 128, 256, or only the size named in the quote), for every valid main seed. effect = |truncated mean - full mean| (same seeds). bestaetigt if at least 2 valid seeds and the largest effect >= tolerance / 4; widerlegt if at least 2 valid seeds and all effects < tolerance / 4; offen otherwise.
